reason: I left over price and had no complaint, so A's line that I told them why I left doesn't fit me, and its placeholders make it feel generic. B gives me the details that make a $99 trial easy to try: no contract, cancel any time, a December 31 deadline and a phone number. It also backs up the cleaner change with the fact that only 1 of 18 cleaners has left since July, and it points out that the cheaper app services don't carry insurance on the visit.
